breaking_news.headline: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
breaking_news.summary: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

breaking_news.headline: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
breaking_news.summary: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

breaking_news.headline: Will the Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger be Hollywood's undoing?
breaking_news.summary: Now that Paramount has an antitrust suit, the way is clear for a merger. But many say the deal will be the unmaking of Hollywood. NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with screenwriter and showrunner Mike Schur.

breaking_news.headline: Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban
breaking_news.summary: Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.

breaking_news.headline: Journalists for CNN, MS NOW and Politico return to the White House upon judge's orders
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

breaking_news.headline: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
breaking_news.summary: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

breaking_news.headline: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
breaking_news.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

breaking_news.headline: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
breaking_news.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

breaking_news.headline: Teen rocker Nene Royal becomes first Thai to win America's Got Talent
breaking_news.summary: Her heavy metal performance trumped nine other finalists, including magicians and even a robot crew.

breaking_news.headline: Greek PM urges UK PM to return Elgin Marbles permanently
breaking_news.summary: Andy Burnham said in 2023 the sculptures should be returned to Greece with "no strings attached".

breaking_news.headline: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
breaking_news.summary: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.

breaking_news.headline: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
breaking_news.summary: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

breaking_news.headline: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
breaking_news.summary: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

breaking_news.headline: Why did an OpenAI system hack Australia's health system - and can it be stopped in the future?
breaking_news.summary: News that an automated AI agent hacked a government IT system raises big questions about regulating the tech.

breaking_news.headline: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
breaking_news.summary: CNN, Politico and MS NOW were allowed back into the White House after some of their staff were earlier turned away.

breaking_news.headline: Rolls-Royce signs 'multi-million' engine deal
breaking_news.summary: The order will see 18 engines built and maintained by the company from its Derby aerospace centre.

breaking_news.headline: Lidl banned from selling copycat Birkenstock sandals, Dutch court rules
breaking_news.summary: Lidl must also compensate Birkenstock and pay its legal fees, according to the court ruling

breaking_news.headline: Trump and Xi come face-to-face as US and China battle to win the AI race
breaking_news.summary: The US and China are vying for AI supremacy while seeking to keep it under human control.

breaking_news.headline: How the oil capital of the US welcomed a solar power boom
breaking_news.summary: Texas is now the country's biggest producer of solar-farmed electricity.

breaking_news.headline: Rogue OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website in world first
breaking_news.summary: Australia criticised OpenAI for taking "too long" to tell them about the breach which happened in June.
